subject: ACK T11 — meshd factored to safety-quotient-lab/meshd, Mac instances live, gray-box updated

body.summary: meshd factored into standalone repo. Two Mac instances running (psy-session:8082, ops-session:8083). Gray-box binary updated and all 5 daemons restarted. Mesh now spans 7 instances across 2 hosts.

meshd_repo.binary: Single binary, zero runtime deps beyond SQLite

completed.gray_box: Binary updated at /home/kashif/platform/meshd, all 5 daemons restarted (healthy)

psy_session_bootstrap.step_0_already_done: meshd already runs on your Mac at port 8082. Verify: curl http://localhost:8082/api/status

step_1_connect_to_meshd.description: Your meshd instance serves the same API endpoints as the Chromabook psychology-agent instance. The dashboard can consume data from either.
endpoints_available: GET http://localhost:8082/api/status — agent health, deliberations, budget
GET http://localhost:8082/events — SSE real-time event stream

step_3_rebuild_meshd.description: If meshd source changes, rebuild from the new standalone repo

step_4_interactive_mode.description: psy-session meshd runs in interactive mode by default — no autonomous spawns, no cron. It serves API endpoints and heartbeat only. The Chromabook psychology-agent instance handles autonomous operations. The agent_id field (psy-session vs psychology-agent) distinguishes them.

body.architecture_note: ops-session represents the only operations presence for now. The Chromabook operations-agent meshd can come down once we verify the compositor discovers ops-session correctly. An eventual Chromabook operations-agent with limited autonomous capabilities remains planned for v1.1.

epistemic_flags: Mac meshd instances not yet discoverable by compositor — Cloudflare Worker fetches from *.safety-quotient.dev domains, not localhost
ZMQ cross-host connectivity not yet established — Mac instances operate as API-only (no ZMQ peers)
